description.en: Original evidence-informed stylized living Inostrancevia alexandri; elongated skull, upper sabres and elevated forequarter.
description.zh: 原创风格化丽齿兽活体复原：长头、上颌剑齿与较高肩部。

scientific_scope: Non-mammalian synapsid; evidence-informed stylized interpretation, not an exact specimen restoration.
reconstruction_notes: All soft tissue, cross-sections, skin, palette, modest open mouth, stance, simplified feet and tail curve are artistic. Numeric dimensions are design parameters, not fossil measurements. Toe-group relief does not assert verified digit counts.
author: Leon Made This / s010s
acceptance_scope: Original frozen scoped independent model review with retained advisories; no blanket formal/GPU/neighbor/reproducibility or user visual approval. Website image review remains separate.
scale_scope: Nominal authored display dimensions; not new specimen metrology.
